description: React component for displaying a product page in an e-commerce application, including product details, reviews, and add/remove from cart functionality.

classes.name: ProductPage
classes.description: React component class for the product detail page, handling lifecycle events, rendering product info, reviews, and cart actions.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches product and reviews data based on URL slug, adds CSS class to body.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Refetches product data if URL slug changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the product page UI, including product details, stock status, image, reviews, and add/remove from cart buttons.
